blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — In front of the biggest crowd the league had ever seen, Alpha Insurance newcomer Axel Van Book showed he belonged on the big stage. Book rose to the occasion, helping the Protectors pull off a stunning 25-22, 19-25, 26-24, 22-25, 16-14 upset of star-studded Savouge Spin Doctors for a winning start in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference before 13,180 fans at the SM Seaside Cebu Arena on October 10. Despite the nerves of playing before a record crowd, the reigning NCAA MVP erupted for 21 points on 19 attacks and two blocks while chipping in six excellent […]...
